body:
Okay this was quite tough.
It was impossible to test the cache behavior of InfiniteHits with "pagination" widget, because whenever page changes, connectPagination refined the search. And that's not the behavior we want to test.

So I added two integration tests.
The first one is a basic test checking if `read` and `write` methods of the cache are being called correctly.

The second one is more similar to what I manually tested on the example website.
It creates a `instantsearch()` instance and add InfiniteHits. It "loads more" to the second page.
Now we have the hits of the two pages in the cache.

With that cache, we create another `instantsearch()` instance and see if the InfiniteHits widget correctly displays the whole hits from the cache.

What do you think?
